summary: Full backend + frontend regression for FITUR BARU 'Cetak Struk dari Gambar' (OCR bukti pembayaran, disimpan terpisah dari transaksi). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_ocr_bukti.py — 5/5 PASS. (a) POST /api/ocr/bukti with a synthetic PNG (base64) containing 'ShopeePay Rp75.000 Kepada TOKO BAGUS SEMBAKO Tanggal 22 Agustus 2026 Waktu 14:35 No. Referensi 2026082212345678' returns {fields:{...}} where amount.value === 75000 (integer, not float, not string), amount.confident=true; method contains 'ShopeePay', recipient contains 'TOKO BAGUS', time contains '14:35', ref contains '2026082212345678'. (b) OCR 'jangan menebak' — a deliberately partial receipt (only 'GoPay' + 'Kepada Warung Sayur Ibu Ani') yields amount/time/ref with confident=false (value=null or forced-null via _norm_field). (c) Empty image_base64 → HTTP 400. (d) POST /api/sync/push with bukti:[{id:'b1', doc:{method:'GoPay',...}, updated_at:1755800000000}] under store='TEST-OCR-<ts>' + subsequent GET /api/sync/pull?store=&since=0 returns {'bukti':[{id:'b1', doc:{method:'GoPay', amount:5000, customer:'Budi', ...}}]} — new key confirmed. (e) LWW semantics on s_bukti: newer updated_at kept, older push ignored (verified). Frontend (Expo web preview @ EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, viewport 390x844): (1) Tab Riwayat has new camera icon testID=riwayat-bukti-scan (7th icon in header actions) — tap navigates to /baca-bukti. (2) /baca-bukti manual entry: filled Metode='DANA', Nominal='25000' (help text 'Rp25.000' rendered in brand color per numberID formatter), Penerima='Toko Uji', Tanggal='22 Agu 2026', Waktu='10:00', No.Ref='REF123', Pelanggan='Sari'. Tap bukti-finish → api.saveBukti persists to in-memory buktiList (web) / SQLite (native), router.replace('/') lands on Transaksi tab. (3) Riwayat: after tapping riwayat-filter-all then riwayat-filter-bukti (both via dispatched PointerEvent because horizontal ScrollView needed manual centering), bukti card renders with badge 'BUKTI', method 'DANA', 'Rp25.000', customer 'Sari' and date-time subtitle ('22 Agu 2026 · HH:MM · Sari'). Bukti hint reads 'Semua Transaksi · 1 bukti · tidak dihitung di omzet'. Verified riwayat-summary omzet REMAINS 9.288.300 (103 seed transactions) — bukti is NOT added to omzet. When bukti chip is ON, summary is hidden (per showBukti guard). (4) Reprint: tapping the bukti card (testID riwayat-bukti-<id>) navigates to /baca-bukti?id=...&method=DANA&amount=25000&customer=Sari&... and inputs are prefilled correctly (bukti-amount input value = '25000', method='DANA', customer='Sari', recipient='Toko Uji'). (5) Long-press → delete confirm: code path present in riwayat.tsx (onLongPress={() => removeBukti(item)} → Alert.alert 'Hapus Bukti?' with 'Batal'/'Hapus') — NOT reliably reproducible in Playwright web preview because RN Alert.alert on react-native-web maps to a Modal that opens only under actual long-press timing on touch pointer; the code path itself is correct. Native actions (bukti-print, bukti-share, bukti-save-img, bukti-save-pdf, bukti-pick) all present and enabled (native-only per agent-to-agent note; verified they render, no crash). Deprecated Expo packages detected — see react_native_issues.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py:704 _norm_field: correctly force-sets confident=false when value is null/empty/'null'/'-' — enforces 'jangan menebak' policy. amount integer coercion at line 785 strips non-digits and marks confident=false if the string had no digits. Good defensive parsing.

backend/server.py:757 ocr_bukti: strips 'data:image/...;base64,' prefix if included; supports both Emergent (Gemini 3 Flash) and OpenAI-compatible providers via LLM_PROVIDER env — matches portability spec.

backend/server.py:575 sync_pull uses same tq (transaction-cursor-query) for bukti — since bukti is time-indexed on srv_at like transactions, delta pull works. Ensure `db.s_bukti.create_index([('store',1),('id',1)])` and `('store',1),('updated_at',1))` exist (present at startup L972-973). ✓
backend/server.py:625 sync_push: LWW check for bukti mirrors products/transactions — older updated_at silently skipped. ✓

frontend/app/baca-bukti.tsx:73 uncertain-count toast: `Object.values(f).filter((x) => !x?.confident).length` — correct. Empty-string values are also normalized to null in _norm_field. UI warnChip renders when warn[k] true (i.e., !confident) → good.

frontend/app/(tabs)/riwayat.tsx: filteredBukti reduces to selected period via sameDay(b.created_at, ...) — same rule as transactions; omzet reducer only iterates `filtered` (transactions) so bukti amount is NEVER added to omzet. ✓ (Confirmed in UI: omzet stayed 9.288.300 with a new Rp25.000 bukti.)
frontend/src/localdb.ts:315 saveBukti: idempotent on payload.id (existing preserves created_at). deleteBukti removes from list + SQLite bukti table. Sort keeps DESC. ✓
frontend/src/localdb.ts:697 collectDirty strips image_uri before sending to server (privacy/size). ✓
frontend/src/localdb.ts:737 applyRemote for bukti: LWW by updated_at ms, keeps local image_uri on merge (image stays on device). ✓
frontend/app/(tabs)/riwayat.tsx:157 openBukti passes String(b.amount) via router params; baca-bukti's initial state normalizes with .replace(/[^\d]/g,'') → integer-safe prefill. ✓
frontend/app/baca-bukti.tsx:149 validate blocks finish/print/share/save when amount <= 0 — prevents empty bukti. Toast shown; state cleared on abort.

Payload contract to /api/ocr/bukti matches OcrBuktiIn (image_base64 + optional mime_type). Response envelope {fields:{method,recipient,amount,date,time,ref}} matches OcrBuktiResult in frontend/src/api.ts.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) For OCR tests, ALWAYS build a PIL PNG containing REAL glyphs (not a solid color) — helper _make_receipt_image in /app/backend/tests/test_ocr_bukti.py adds a border+banner+text so the image passes the vision model's minimum-content heuristic and image_testing.md rules (PNG/JPEG, base64, textured). 2) The Riwayat filter chip row is a horizontal ScrollView; RN-web renders chips in one strip that overflows the viewport at 390px — 'Semua' chip is off-screen. Use page.evaluate() dispatching PointerEvent (pointerdown/up + click) after scrollIntoView with block:'center', inline:'center'. 3) The bukti card testID is dynamic (riwayat-bukti-<id>); enumerate via querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="riwayat-bukti-"]') and exclude 'riwayat-bukti-scan' + 'riwayat-bukti-hint'. 4) Long-press → Alert.alert is native-only in this app; on web react-native-web uses a Modal that only opens on touch-timing long-press, which Playwright pointerdown+setTimeout(800)+pointerup does not reliably trigger. Verify the JS handler is wired (onLongPress={() => removeBukti(item)}) via code review; skip functional test. 5) After bukti-finish, router.replace('/') triggers navigation to Transaksi tab (index route). On web, in-memory buktiList persists across route changes but NOT across window reloads — do not use page.reload() between save and Riwayat verification. 6) The web preview's Miko mascot bubble sometimes overlaps bottom-right of Riwayat; if a chip click misses, first move the mouse away or use dispatched events. 7) Backend /api/ocr/bukti uses Gemini 3 Flash via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — response takes ~2-8s per call.
rca_of_issue: No production bugs found. Note: On my first Playwright run, the bukti card appeared missing after finish→Riwayat. Root cause was NOT a bug: I clicked the 'Bukti Bayar' chip via element.click() which fires only click, missing RN-web's Pressable pointer-event handlers on some renders; when I switched to dispatching PointerEvent (pointerdown + pointerup + click) the state toggle worked and the card appeared. Real users on mobile use native touch events which include pointerdown/pointerup, so no user-facing issue exists.
